the_day: Anthropic's shares fell on their second day of trading and one of its mathematicians claimed a Claude-assisted Riemann proof; OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Plus features and was sued by Oregon; Google redesigned its homepage around Gemini; Meta is reported to be reconsidering a climate goal; xAI had no new changes.

items.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims Claude helped prove the Riemann hypothesis
points: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims he proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from Claude.
The Verge notes it is one of the Millennium Prize problems; Tom's Hardware says the proof remains unconfirmed.
None of today's items includes a statement from Anthropic itself.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO total rises to $93.5 billion as shares fall
points: CNBC reports underwriters used the greenshoe overallotment option, bringing Anthropic's total IPO raise to $93.5 billion.
Reuters reports the IPO bank has closed a position meant to stabilise the stock, and shares fell 13% on day two.
Reuters put the original record offering at $81 billion, valuing Anthropic at $1.5 trillion.
